themes_detail.label: Street Vending Crackdown Surge
themes_detail.summary: Vendor enforcement complaints spiked dramatically to 12 THIS WEEK, an 860% increase from the 1.2 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score 11.1), suggesting either a sudden enforcement campaign or emerging vendor conflicts in Morningside Heights/Hamilton Heights.
evidence: 12 vendor enforcement complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.2 weekly average (8-week baseline)
Timing aligns with possible NYPD or DOC enforcement push—no prior context in data
reporting_angles: Interview street vendors about sudden enforcement intensity; are they being targeted or relocated?
Obtain DOC/NYPD enforcement logs to confirm whether a campaign launched this week
Speak to merchants and residents about vendor presence and whether complaints prompted action

themes_detail.label: Drug Activity Spike Last Week
themes_detail.summary: Drug activity complaints reached 13 LAST WEEK, a 225% increase from the 4.0 weekly average (z-score 4.81), indicating a possible uptick in open-air drug use or sales in the district.
evidence: 13 drug activity complaints LAST WEEK vs. 4.0 weekly average (8-week baseline)
Aligns with recent shooting incident reported by amNewYork (2026-05-08) in district
reporting_angles: Map the 13 complaints to identify geographic hot spots (parks, transit corridors, residential blocks)
Interview NYPD Morningside Heights precinct about enforcement response
Talk to community safety advocates and residents about visible drug activity patterns

themes_detail.label: Homeless Outreach Surge 2 Weeks Ago
themes_detail.summary: Requests for homeless person assistance spiked to 17 TWO WEEKS AGO, a 404% increase from the 3.4 weekly average (z-score 5.46), suggesting either a visible encampment emergence or increased crisis calls.
evidence: 17 homeless person assistance complaints TWO WEEKS AGO vs. 3.4 weekly average
Community Board has repeated budget requests for 'outreach services to homebound older adults'—persistent systemic gap
reporting_angles: Locate the 17 complaints geographically; is there a concentration at parks (Morningside Park), transit hubs, or shelters?
Contact DHS/Homeless Services to understand whether a new encampment formed or shelter crisis occurred
Interview residents and local advocates about visible homelessness and available services in the district

themes_detail.label: Water Quality Complaints 2 Weeks Ago
themes_detail.summary: Water quality complaints reached 3 TWO WEEKS AGO, a 700% increase from the 0.4 weekly average (z-score 5.42), suggesting a potential water main break, contamination, or discoloration event affecting multiple residents.
evidence: 3 water quality complaints TWO WEEKS AGO vs. 0.4 weekly average
Aligns with broader heat/hot water crisis (3,008 complaints over 90 days)—suggests infrastructure stress
reporting_angles: Request DEP incident logs for water main breaks, discoloration events, or boil water notices in the district two weeks ago
Interview DEP about scope and cause of the water quality event
Speak to affected residents about water safety concerns and whether they received official notification

themes_detail.label: Street Lighting Deterioration 2 Weeks Ago
themes_detail.summary: Street light condition complaints jumped to 14 TWO WEEKS AGO, a 149% increase from the 5.6 weekly average (z-score 4.2), pointing to widespread outages or a maintenance failure affecting safety and visibility.
evidence: 14 street light complaints TWO WEEKS AGO vs. 5.6 weekly average
Timing overlaps with drug activity spike and homeless assistance requests—suggests interconnected public safety and infrastructure concerns
reporting_angles: Request DOE streetlight outage logs for the district from two weeks ago; identify clusters
Interview DOE about repair timelines and current restoration status
Talk to residents about safety concerns related to darkened streets, especially in context of rising drug and homelessness complaints
